answer: Here is one mechanism that works: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because nectar only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, pulse is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any mesa approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
